metadata.description: Ideation Hub plugins: platform (schema, REST, MCP), developer, and requirements. The root ideation-hub entry remains so existing installs keep loading.

plugins.name: ideation-hub-platform
plugins.description: Canonical Ideation Hub schema, REST API, and MCP tools. The developer and requirements plugins require this plugin. Cursor has no dependency field; install it with them.

plugins.name: ideation-hub-developer
plugins.description: Developer plugin for system design, implementation, and assessment. Requires the Ideation Hub platform plugin. Cursor has no dependency field. The ideation-hub-system-design name still resolves.

plugins.name: ideation-hub-requirements
plugins.description: Requirements plugin for authoring Business Needs, User Needs, and Product Requirements. Skill name ideation-hub-requirements-agent is unchanged. Requires the Ideation Hub platform plugin. Cursor has no dependency field.

plugins.name: ideation-hub
plugins.description: Compatibility bundle for existing installs. Loads the developer and requirements instructions and the root MCP server. Prefer the platform, developer, and requirements plugins. Do not install this bundle together with those three.
